body: Rebuild the uploaded icon as a small three-dimensional object covered in dense soft fur. Keep its silhouette and essential color areas instantly recognizable. Show individual fibers catching the light, rounded padded volume and a soft shadow beneath it. Float the object against a light neutral studio backdrop. Use a close product-photography composition without adding any text.
